title: Evidence for Hypodescent in Visual Semantic AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating hypodescent (the one-drop rule) and default racial categorization by comparing the zero-shot cosine similarities of CLIP text embeddings for racial/ethnic labels to GAN-generated facial morph series blending minority (Black, Asian, Latino/a) and majority (White) faces. Additionally, measuring implicit valence (pleasant vs. unpleasant) associations with racialized images using a Single-Category Word Embedding Association Test (SC-WEAT).

Comparing the strength of hypodescent and racial categorization biases in CLIP between male-to-male and female-to-female facial morph series to observe intersectional disparities (finding that hypodescent is applied more strongly to images of women).
